definitions: A rough or unfinished drawing or painting, often made to assist in the production of a more finished picture.
A brief written or spoken account or description.
A short humorous play or performance, typically part of a revue or show.
A brief outline or general survey of something.
examples: He made a quick sketch of the landscape.
The artist's sketchbook was full of preliminary sketches.
She gave a brief sketch of her life story.
The comedy show featured several hilarious sketches.
The report provided a sketch of the economic situation.
